name: Branoc Hall Playpark
description: A children's playpark by the playing field behind Branoc Hall, the village hall in the centre of Branscombe. The hall says the playing field is open to the public at all times; on summer cricket match days the team may ask for the field to be cleared. The hall's car park, behind the hall, is free to use, with donations welcome.
